shortDescription: Amazon.com NASDAQ:AMZN suspended operations with cargo carrier 21 Air, which operated the Sept. 6 flight that overran the runway at Miami International Airport, killing five people on the ground.“We’ve spent time supporting the investigation and reviewing some of the surrounding circumstances, and…

children: suspended operations with cargo carrier 21 Air, which operated the Sept. 6 flight that overran the runway at Miami International Airport, killing five people on the ground.

“We’ve spent time supporting the investigation and reviewing some of the surrounding circumstances, and we’ve decided to pause our operations with 21 Air,” Amazon said on its news blog Sunday. “We’ll continue working to support the investigation and everyone affected.”

The Boeing 767 freighter, Flight 7598, ran off the runway and struck two vehicles. The NTSB said cockpit audio showed one pilot called for the landing to be aborted after the aircraft touched down at excessive speed.
21 Air said it’s “confident in our safety policies, procedures and training” and remains focused on “working closely with the NTSB and all our partners, like Amazon, as the investigation continues.”
All five people killed and five others injured were occupants of the two vehicles struck by the aircraft.

title: Amazon suspends operations with 21 Air after fatal Miami crash
